cleaner.label: Deno
cleaner.description: Deno modules, npm packages and compile cache. Does not touch the origin data (location_data), the REPL history or installed programs.

option.label: Deno remote modules and npm packages
option.description: Removes the modules downloaded from remote addresses and the cached npm packages.
option.warning: Re-downloaded the next time the programs run or with `deno cache`.

option.label: Deno compile and analysis cache
option.description: Removes the emitted code, the language server registry cache, the files downloaded by deno upgrade and the analysis databases.
